verdict.rationale: monday.com gives each agent its own identity (monday-docs-1, monday-docs-12). Admins can scope each agent's board access and audit every action it takes (monday-docs-10, monday-docs-43), and apps can request granular scopes like `boards:read` with keys held in managed secret storage (monday-docs-6). Together these cover the core of least-privilege agent credentials, but all of it comes from marketing-level developer-site copy. missing for 10: explicit docs on minting per-agent API tokens or keys with chosen scopes, the full scope catalog and how fine-grained it is, token rotation and expiry, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
